name: Paribus
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the DeFiHackLabs root-cause title.
rootCause: The Paribus Protocol exploit likely stemmed from a logical vulnerability in how the protocol handled its pTokens (interest-bearing tokens) and their interaction with the underlying lending/borrowing mechanisms, potentially in conjunction with the handling of NFT positions representing collateral. Vulnerable code snippet: https://arbiscan.io/address/0xaffd437801434643b734d0b2853654876f66f7d7 Attack tx: https://arbiscan.io/tx/0xf5e753d3da60db214f2261343c1e1bc46e674d2fa4b7a953eaf3c52123aeebd2 Analysis: https://bitfinding.com/blog/paribus-hack-interception https://x.com/paribus_io/status/1881423579625271472
